JWK thumbprint

Source: R/thumbprint.R
jwk_thumbprint.Rd

jwk_thumbprint() computes a key's RFC 7638 thumbprint: the hash of its required members, in lexicographic order, as JSON without whitespace. With uri = TRUE it returns the RFC 9278 thumbprint URI.

Usage

jwk_thumbprint(key, hash = "sha256", uri = FALSE)

Arguments

key

A jwk.

hash

"sha256", "sha384" or "sha512".

uri

Whether to return a urn:ietf:params:oauth:jwk-thumbprint URI rather than the bare Base64url value.

Value

A single string.

Details

The thumbprint of a private key equals that of its public key, since private members are never part of it. It is a common kid; see jwk_with_kid().

Examples

key <- jwk_oct(as.raw(1:32))
jwk_thumbprint(key)
#> [1] "f7NOASX-o7koLb0W4ErF0hSMzu1Fp3joD078YB3yAyY"
jwk_thumbprint(key, uri = TRUE)
#> [1] "urn:ietf:params:oauth:jwk-thumbprint:sha-256:f7NOASX-o7koLb0W4ErF0hSMzu1Fp3joD078YB3yAyY"
